d.ko: Universe Wars is a multiplayer game similar to Plants vs. Zombies. Plants become evil Earthlings, and zombies become cuddly three-eyed aliens. And on the basis of "Plants vs. Zombies" and increased the multiplayer online, fashion system, formation evolution, protagonist system.

d.zh: 《宇宙大战》是类似《植物大战僵尸》的的多人联机游戏。植物变成了邪恶的地球人，僵尸变成了萌宠的三眼外星人。并在《植物大战僵尸》的基础上并且增加了多人联机，时装系统，养成进化、主角系统，等有趣玩法，同时增加了上百种有趣搞怪的新卡。
